readings.heading: Ὁ Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ἁγίου Τίχωνος — Hebrews 7:26–8:2
verses: 26. Brothers and sisters: this is exactly the kind of high priest we needed — devout, without guile, unstained, set apart from sinners, and raised higher than the heavens.
27. He has no need, as the high priests do, to offer sacrifices day after day — first for his own sins, and then for the people's. He did this once for all, when he offered up himself.
28. For the law appoints as high priests men who have weakness; but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son, made perfect for ever.
1. Now the crowning point of all we are saying: we have such a high priest, who sat down at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,
2. a minister of the holy things and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched — not man.

readings.heading: Τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἁγίου Τίχωνος — Matthew 5:14–19
verses: 14. At that time the Lord said to his disciples: "You are the light of the world. A city set on a hill cannot be hidden.
15. Nor do people light a lamp and put it under a bushel basket — they put it on the lampstand, and it gives light to everyone in the house.
16. Let your light shine like that in front of others, so that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in the heavens.
17. Do not think that I came to abolish the law or the prophets. I did not come to abolish them, but to fulfil them.
18. For I tell you the truth: until heaven and earth pass away, not one iota, not one little stroke will pass from the law, until everything has taken place.

19. So whoever breaks one of the least of these commandments and teaches others to do the same will be called least in the kingdom of the heavens; but whoever does them and teaches them, that person will be called great in the kingdom of the heavens."

readings.heading: Ὁ Ἀπόστολος τῆς ἡμέρας — 2 Corinthians 4:1–6
verses: 1. Brothers and sisters: so, since we have this ministry by the mercy we have received, we do not lose heart.

2. We have renounced the hidden, shameful things. We do not behave craftily, and we do not tamper with the word of God. Instead, by setting out the truth plainly, we commend ourselves to every human conscience, in the sight of God.
3. And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled among those who are perishing —
4. among them, the god of this age has blinded the minds of the unbelievers, so that the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, does not dawn on them.
5. For we do not preach ourselves; we preach Christ Jesus as Lord — and ourselves as your servants for Jesus' sake.
6. Because the God who said, "Let light shine out of darkness," is the one who has shone in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

readings.heading: Τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἡμέρας — Matthew 24:13–28
verses: 13. At that time the Lord said: "But the one who endures to the end — that is the one who will be saved.
14. And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in the whole inhabited world, as a witness to all the nations — and then the end will come.
15. So when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of through the prophet Daniel, standing in the holy place — let the reader understand —
16. then let those in Judea flee to the mountains.
17. Let the one on the housetop not come down to take anything out of his house,
18. and let the one in the field not turn back to pick up his cloak.
19. Alas for those who are with child and for those nursing infants in those days!
20. Pray that your flight may not come in winter, or on a sabbath.
21. For then there will be a great affliction, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, and never will be again.
22. And if those days had not been cut short, no flesh would be saved; but for the sake of the elect, those days will be cut short.
23. Then, if anyone says to you, 'Look, here is the Christ,' or 'Here,' do not believe it.
24. For false christs and false prophets will rise, and they will give great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the elect.
25. Look — I have told you in advance.
26. So if they say to you, 'Look, he is in the desert,' do not go out. 'Look, he is in the inner rooms,' do not believe it.
27. For as the lightning comes out from the east and shines as far as the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
28. Wherever the carcass may be, there the eagles will gather."
